best_for: Teams replacing a stitched-together stack - Typeform or Jotform plus Airtable or Notion plus Zapier or Make plus Mailchimp plus a Clay-style enrichment tool plus a chatbot - with one login, one bill and one data model: forms that call apps mid-fill, tables that hold the records, workflows with 60+ node types across 458 integrations, AI agents that read and act on your own data, email campaigns sent from those tables, and login-gated client portals. It fits solo operators on the free-forever tier, growing teams that want the agent builder at $49/mo, and agencies that need many workspaces and seats at $149/mo. Not a fit if you need the single best tool in any one category (the point here is breadth, not depth), a native mobile or desktop app (the platform is browser-only), a published sub-processor list to hand to a compliance reviewer today, a longer execution history than 15 days on Free and Basic, or if the Black Friday and lifetime offers matter to you - both are real but neither is mentioned on the pricing page.
